fn_strict.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_strict(n int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql STRICT AS $$ SELECT widget $$

fn_strict_long.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_strict_long(n int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT AS $$ SELECT gadget $$

fn_called.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_called(n int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT widget $$

fn_default_word.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_default_word(note text DEFAULT 'strict') RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT widget $$
